body:
New stdlib/pentest/dot11.prn -- real, native PARENA (no FFI needed, existing bit-and/bit-or/shl/shr/char-at sufficient). Real, decisive limitation found and fixed: string.prn's own length is strlen-based, which would silently truncate a real 802.11 frame at its own legitimate embedded zero bytes -- parse-frame now takes the real frame byte-length as an explicit required parameter. New make test-pentest-dot11 target, real end-to-end test against a hand-constructed, spec-accurate Beacon frame, 5/5 assertions pass (Beacon detection, BSSID/SSID extraction, 2 honest degenerate cases). make test 345/345 zero regressions. Real, honest limitation: no third-party dissector (tshark/scapy) could be gotten running in this sandbox to cross-check the bytes independently (a much deeper dependency chain than nmap's own, which WAS fully resolved this session) -- correctness rests on the spec construction itself.

⚓ ☃
title: PENT-11412...PENT-0011: real native Radiotap+802.11 Beacon frame parser shipped (Kismet Phase 1)
